description: This PHP source file defines the 'ProjectActivityReport' class, which extends 'ProjectReport' and resides within the namespace 'OrangeHRM	imeeport'. The class handles report generation related to project activities, including preparing filter parameters from request data, validation rules, header definitions for the report, and data retrieval for detailed project activity reports. It leverages traits, external classes, and constants to construct report metadata and processing logic within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: ProjectActivityReport
classes.description: Handles the generation of detailed project activity reports, including parsing request parameters, validating inputs, defining report headers, and retrieving report data.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Extracts and prepares filter parameters for the report from the request endpoint, including project ID, activity ID, date range, and inclusion of timesheet approvals.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the report request parameters, ensuring necessary fields like activity ID are provided and valid.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Constructs and returns the report header layout, including employee name and time columns with internationalization support.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on the provided filter parameters, returning a detailed project activity report.
